title: Finite affine relative covers with prescribed sieve membership
statement: Let X be a qcqs scheme and M,E etale X-schemes with M quasi-compact. Let e:E to M be surjective, R a sieve on E covering for the small etale topology of X. There exist an etale X-scheme N, a map nu:N to E, and a finite coproduct cofan W_i to N such that nu followed by e is surjective and every constituent map W_i to E belongs to R. Each W_i is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and its structure morphism to X is locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. No compactness assumption is imposed on E.

source.place: Lemma 25.7.3 (01GJ), covering refinement; Lemma 25.12.6 (094K), finite-basis choices; finite affine extraction uses Mathlib QuasiCompactCover.exists_isAffineOpen_of_isCompact.

proof.text: Realize the covering sieve R by an etale scheme covering C_i of E, with its morphisms to E in R, using Scheme.mem_smallGrothendieckTopology. Composing with e gives an etale covering D of M: lift a point of M to E using surjectivity, then lift it to a member of C.

Every member map of D is open. QuasiCompactCover.of_isOpenMap and exists_isAffineOpen_of_isCompact select finitely many affine opens of its members whose images cover M. This is the compact-target version of the same Mathlib API recorded at the finite affine refinement leaf.

Let W_i be the affine Spec schemes of these opens, with their etale structure maps to X. Let N be their coproduct in X.Etale and nu its induced map to E. The selected covering images prove surjectivity of nu followed by e by exhibiting preimages through coproduct injections. The standard coproduct cofan is colimiting. Affineness gives qcqs, etaleness gives local finite presentation, and compact source and quasi-separated source give the other two morphism properties. Each W_i to E factors through the original covering arrow in R; the sieve is downward closed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_etale_sieve_cover
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (M E : X.Etale) [CompactSpace M.left] (e : E ⟶ M) (he : Surjective e.left)
    (R : Sieve E) (hR : R ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology E) :
    ∃ (N : X.Etale) (ν : N ⟶ E) (k : ℕ) (W : Fin k → X.Etale)
      (ι : ∀ i, W i ⟶ N),
      Surjective (ν ≫ e).left ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk N ι)) ∧
        (∀ i, CompactSpace (W i).left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (W i).left ∧
          LocallyOfFinitePresentation (W i).hom ∧ QuasiCompact (W i).hom ∧
            QuasiSeparated (W i).hom) ∧ ∀ i, R (ι i ≫ ν)
